task.instructions:
Using matplotlib, draw a scatter plot of exam score against hours studied for twelve students. Draw it with a single call to `Axes.scatter` (not `Axes.plot`), so the points stay unconnected markers.
The twelve (hours studied, exam score) pairs, in this order, are:
(1.0, 52), (1.5, 55), (2.0, 58), (2.5, 61), (3.0, 63), (3.5, 68), (4.0, 70), (4.5, 72), (5.0, 75), (5.5, 77), (6.0, 80), (6.5, 84).
Put hours studied on the x axis and exam score on the y axis.
Draw everything on a single set of axes (one Axes, no subplots and no colorbar).
Give the chart a title and label both axes.
